response.text: The unlinked AP journals are payment journals (SRC_REF "PAY-n"), so they are not an orphan issue. Let me check whether these payment journals agree with APPAYM amounts, and whether the 538 payments tie to their journals.

arguments.sql: SELECT p."PAY_ID", p."PAY_AMT", h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM public."APPAYM" p JOIN public."GLJRNH" h ON h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" JOIN public."GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY p."PAY_ID", p."PAY_AMT", h."JRNL_NO" HAVING ROUND(SUM(l."DR_AMT")::numeric,2)<>ROUND(p."PAY_AMT"::numeric,2) LIMIT 50
